name: Pocket City 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Drive and walk about a city of five districts seen from above. In a car: hold Select for the throttle, Prev to brake and reverse, turn the wheel to steer, Play is the handbrake, Next gets out when you stand still (or sounds the horn). On foot: the wheel turns, Select walks, Play with it runs, Next gets into the nearest car. The next job waits at a phone box: follow the yellow arrow. Red lights, ramming and knocking people down bring the police: lose them, or get fresh paint at a paint shop. Thirty tapes are lost about the city. The city map is in the pause menu.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel turns the front wheels, and they come back straight when you stop. Thumb: the wheels follow where your thumb rests, right or left of the top.

options.name: sounds
options.title: Engine and siren
options.help: The engine, the tyres and the police sirens.

achievements.title: Clean Getaway
achievements.text: Lose the police after three stars.
